title: Hook, Wine, and Sinker Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Experience unparalleled luxury in the heart of Seaside with this stunning, modern penthouse. Across the street from beach pavilion access and located in 25 Central Square. Two minute walk to beach & 1 minute walk to over 35 shops & restaurants.
description_expanded: Description25 CENTRAL SQUARE, UNIT 3072 KINGS, QUEEN SLEEPER SOFAPrime Central Square Penthouse Living in Seaside, FloridaHook, Wine, and Sinker is a spacious two-story penthouse apartment offering the very best of New Urbanism living in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Located on the third and fourth floors of the iconic 25 Central Square Building, this beautifully appointed residence places you just steps from the Gulf of Mexico, Seaside’s boutique shopping, and renowned dining scene. Enjoy sweeping Gulf views from your private balcony, rooftop patio, and shared common areas—all while being immersed in the energy of Central Square.Open-Concept Living with Gulf ViewsThe entry level welcomes you with a thoughtfully renovated kitchen featuring modern cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a center island equipped with premium appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Bosch dishwasher, glass-top range, microwave, and both espresso and coffee makers. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six and opens to a porch with café seating—perfect for relaxed meals or morning coffee with coastal breezes.The spacious living room is styled for both relaxation and gathering, offering an American Leather queen sleeper sofa with high-density foam (no bars or springs), designer accent chairs, ambient lighting, and a Samsung LED Smart TV with Sonos PLAYBAR and Bose sound system. All televisions throughout the penthouse are LED Smart TVs, and YouTube TV is provided by the owners, giving guests access to live television, sports, and entertainment during their stay. High-speed wireless internet keeps you connected. Just off the living room, a covered porch with bar-top seating provides an ideal vantage point for Gulf views, sunsets, and Seaside’s signature architecture. A powder room and laundry closet with stackable washer and dryer complete this level.Private Bedroom Suites & Rooftop PatioUpstairs, the penthouse features two serene bedroom retreats. The primary king suite includes designer furnishings from the Mitchell Gold Manning Collection, built-in storage, a LED Smart TV with Youtube TV, and a private en-suite bathroom with updated fixtures and a spacious walk-in shower. The second bedroom also offers a king bed, generous storage, a LED Smart TV with YouTube TV, and access to a full hall bathroom with shower.For exceptional comfort, the primary suite features a luxurious Saatva mattress (new in 2024), while the guest bedroom includes a premium Leesa king mattress (new in 2024). Both bedrooms are dressed with Italian cotton coverlets, plush blankets, and multiple pillow options to personalize your sleep experience. Each bedroom also opens onto a quiet, private rooftop patio furnished with cushioned loungers and reading chairs — an elevated retreat perfect for sunbathing, afternoon relaxation, or evening stargazing in the heart of Seaside.Building Amenities & Effortless AccessThe 25 Central Square Building offers elevator access to the third-floor entry. Inside the penthouse, stairs lead to the upper level and rooftop patio. Guests may also enjoy a shared interior courtyard with cushioned seating, perfect for soaking up the sun or unwinding in the shade.Steps to the Beach & Owner Beach AccessThe beach is directly across the street—just 75 walking steps via Seaside’s Coleman Pavilion. Guests receive wristbands granting access to the exclusive owner section of Seaside’s private residential beach, allowing you to enjoy the Gulf in comfort and style.Perfectly positioned and impeccably designed, Hook, Wine, and Sinker offers a refined coastal retreat where Gulf views, walkability, and Seaside’s signature charm come together for an unforgettable stay.* Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter.FEATURES1,316 Square Feet of spacious interior livingBright Natural Light throughout with large west-facing windowsPrime Central Square Location on the west-facing side of 25 Central Square75 Walking Steps to Beach Access via the Coleman Pavilion (approximately 167 feet / 1-minute walk)One Parking Pass Included; additional vehicles may park in paid public parking areasAdditional Parking Options available behind 25 Central Square, along Quincy Circle, or in designated paid parking areasLiving Area Entertainment includes LED Samsung Smart TV, Sonos PLAYBAR, Blu-Ray DVD player, and Bose sound system with direct phone connectivityEnhanced High-Speed Wireless InternetPeacock Alley Linens – Fresh, luxurious Peacock Alley sheets and towels throughout the homeResort-Style Amenities Access including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a large fitness centerWelcome Tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityStarter Toiletries ProvidedOn-Site & Nearby Conveniences including Amavida Coffee located in the building lobby and Modica Market just a short walk awayGolf Cart Policy: A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners unless approved for special circumstances or medical needs with a permitPersonalized Service offered throughout your stayNo Pets Allowed
